title: What is AI transformation in 2027? How to build a strategy for your business
author: Nicole Replogle
content_snippet: It can feel impossible to escape the pressure to "do something" with AI. Maybe your CEO just asked about your AI strategy in an all-hands, or your competitors are shipping faster thanks to automation. Or maybe you're just tired of watching your team lose hours every week to tasks a bot could easily handle. You know AI is a big deal—but figuring out where to start is where most teams get stuck.
